slot_behavior.occupancy: The title uses a diamond for the active slot, its number for another occupied slot, and a dash for an empty slot.
slot_behavior.store: Save to the first vacant slot. The ninth save has no effect while all eight slots are occupied. Equal positions can occupy separate slots.
slot_behavior.recall: Minus restores the active slot. Alt+1 through Alt+8 select and restore an occupied slot. Empty slots leave the cursor and active slot unchanged.
slot_behavior.delete: Alt+Minus leaves a hole in the numbering and clears the active marker. Alt+0 clears the three mode tables.
slot_behavior.file_switch: Returning to the first of two command-line files started with no populated slots.

restoration.hex: Selecting slot 4 restored file byte 0x171 and first visible row 0x170.
restoration.text: Recalling a screen saved at horizontal column 2 returned from column 4 to column 2 with wrapping off. When wrapping was on, the current wrapping choice stayed on.
restoration.decode: A screen saved at automatic x86-32 restored explicit x86-32 after selecting x86-64 and paging away.
